subject.title: fix(ui): harden browser, session, permissions, and media lifecycles

question: Should this Control UI/QA reliability bundle, including the narrow CI worker-isolation adjustment, land atomically after a current-main rebase and final checks?
rationale: The supplied evidence supports a coherent shared lifecycle-regression bundle, but the protected maintainer label and CI planner scope make atomicity a maintainer-owned release decision rather than an automated cleanup choice.

options.title: Land atomically after refresh
options.body: Rebase the branch, require the final UI, E2E, QA, and compact lanes to pass, then land the tested lifecycle bundle with its scheduler isolation change.

options.title: Split CI scheduling
options.body: Keep the Control UI and QA repairs together but move the test-worker estimate adjustment into a narrowly scoped CI PR with its planner regressions.

recommendation.title: Land atomically after refresh
recommendation.body: Rebase the branch, require the final UI, E2E, QA, and compact lanes to pass, then land the tested lifecycle bundle with its scheduler isolation change.
